<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>;
<span class="hl-kw">import</span> java.util.<span class="hl-type">Map</span>;

<span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">record</span> UserCreatedData(
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> color,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> maybeColor,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> nested,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> oneOfConst,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> mixedConst,
    <span class="hl-type">String</span> objConst
) {

    <span class="hl-comment">@SuppressWarnings</span>(<span class="hl-str">&quot;unchecked&quot;</span>)
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> UserCreatedData fromMap(<span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; map) {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> UserCreatedData(
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;color&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;maybeColor&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nested&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;oneOfConst&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;mixedConst&quot;</span>),
            (<span class="hl-type">String</span>) map.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;objConst&quot;</span>)
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-type">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt; toMap() {
        <span class="hl-kw">var</span> map = <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-type">LinkedHashMap</span>&lt;<span class="hl-type">String</span>, <span class="hl-type">Object</span>&gt;();
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;color&quot;</span>, color);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;maybeColor&quot;</span>, maybeColor);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nested&quot;</span>, nested);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;oneOfConst&quot;</span>, oneOfConst);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;mixedConst&quot;</span>, mixedConst);
        map.put(<span class="hl-str">&quot;objConst&quot;</span>, objConst);
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> map;
    }
}
